title: Feynman and Wheeler's 1945 paper on time-symmetric electromagnetism

tellings.quote: theory Richard feineman in 1945 wrote a key paper with wheeler

plain: In 1945 the physicist Richard Feynman wrote a key paper with the physicist John Wheeler on time-symmetric electromagnetism, the idea that the laws of electricity and light work the same running backward in time as forward. The biologist Rupert Sheldrake brings the paper up with Michels in passing, as support for a theory he is describing, without saying more about what it contains.
